status: proposed 2026-10-12 at the owner's request ("We need to add some shrines or legendary stuff to the starter forest in those clearings."); built as data and functions by tools/maze_shrines.py, audited by tools/maze_shrines_audit.py, not yet seen in any world
note: One small shrine in each of the Route 1 maze forest's three glades (where the braids rejoin) and three secret glades (where the hidden squeeze paths end). The sapling clearing (the sleeping Celebi, data/sapling_celebi.json) and the mansion clearing (the Gastly mansion) are left as they are. A glade stele carries two tablets naming one of the lake spirits and where it sleeps, an offering bowl, and a small find of its own; a secret glade's older shrine speaks of Celebi, Tapu Bulu or Tornadus and stands over the find tools/route_events.py already placed there. Every hint is true: `legendary` names an encounter of data/legendaries.json and tools/maze_shrines_audit.py reads its species, site and status back.

fields.id: unique, lowercase; the function is cobblers:maze_shrines/<id>
fields.name: a working name for the shrine
fields.glade: the id of an opening in tools/maze_forest.py CLEARINGS (kind glade or secret)
fields.at: [x, z] of the shrine's front-centre column; its floor is the highest heightmap ground under it plus one
fields.facing: the side its front (the offerings) faces: north | east | south | west
fields.legendary: {id: a data/legendaries.json encounter id, species, site: that encounter's `site`, direction: optional compass word the tablet says, checked against the bearing from the shrine to the encounter's mouth or portal}
fields.signs: {upper, lower}: the two carved tablets, four lines each, at most 14 characters a line. The upper names the spirit, the lower says where it sleeps
fields.reward: stele only: the data/rewards.json record of its own find (the barrel is this shrine's; the advancement is rewards_pack's)
fields.existing_find: old_shrine only: the data/rewards.json record route_events.py already placed in the glade, which this shrine must keep clear of
fields.why: why this glade, this legendary and this piece

rules.note: Clearances in blocks, enforced by tools/maze_shrines.py and checked again, independently, by tools/maze_shrines_audit.py

blocks.note: Every block a shrine may write. Vanilla 1.21.1 only; tools/maze_shrines_audit.py checks each id against the 1.21.1 client jar's blockstates and against data/spawn_blocks.json. The potted plants are their own block ids, none a spawn condition; the flowers themselves are, and are not used.

shrines.name: the Feeling Stone
shrines.why: the first glade, where braid 1 rejoins: the first of the three lake spirits a player meets, on the first fork of the first route. The Emotion spirit sleeps under Arrow Lake (data/legendaries.json mesprit, 3 badges), a lake east of this forest. Compact, tended: a stele in the pocket east of the junction, its front to the walkers

shrines.name: the Willing Stone
shrines.why: the second glade, beyond the sapling: Azelf's mouth is under the root tangle of the drowned trees in Marshy Marsh (data/legendaries.json azelf, 5 badges)

shrines.name: the Knowing Stone
shrines.why: the third glade, the last before the exit stretch and Brock: Uxie sleeps under the island's apron in Lake Tilpey (data/legendaries.json uxie, 7 badges), far east

shrines.name: the Green Shrine
shrines.why: the fern glade at the end of the hidden path east of braid 1: ferns and old stone for the grass guardian, whose chamber is under the Long Isle's southern hills (data/legendaries.json tapubulu, 6 badges). Older than the stelae: cracked, mossed, candle-lit, the find's barrel left where it was

shrines.name: the Hollow Shrine
shrines.why: the west hollow, the secret glade nearest the sapling (about 210 blocks from it): the forest's own guardian, asleep on the Route 1 sapling's branch (data/sapling_celebi.json, data/legendaries.json celebi_wake). The tablet says it sleeps and says 'not yet'; it names no wake item (docs/story/EARLY_ROUTE_BUILD_HANDOFF.md forbids a Route 1 voice naming one)

shrines.name: the Ring Shrine
shrines.why: the ring of trees at the end of the hidden path off the exit stretch, the last glade before Brock: a ring of leaves is where the wind is loudest, and Tornadus is sealed under the Tri Peaks' summit (data/legendaries.json tornadus, 4 badges), far north
